author: ValentinHirschi <valentin.hirschi@gmail.com>
scope: Opt-in ordinary rational and epsilon-series Padé candidates in the shared transport controller; registered roots retain Taylor.

checks.command: cargo test --release --test pade --test conditioning --test mobius --test epsilon_cache --test mobius_cache --test transport_cache --test algebraic_cache --test complex_ode --locked

independent_review: Arithmetic, native ownership, candidate/saved-output agreement, disk denominator exclusion, refinement and resource wrappers reviewed. Fixed-degree refinement and missing-operation budget findings resolved before final gates.
new_coverage: Exact rational ordinary and epsilon transport including Mobius charts
Accepted rational intermediate output, native point-bank persistence, exact hit and nearby restart
Coupled complex epsilon channels with independent precision and order
Actual [1/1] and [2/2] exponential approximants compared; degree cap uses Taylor reference
Tiny-residue interior pole and high-degree sparse source rejection
Defective approximants, exact zero and constants, preconversion dyadic and finite construction limits
Cancellation/cache immutability and registered-root sheet-preserving Taylor fallback
limitations: Local defect and conditioning checks are not a global forward-error certificate.
Native growth/work bounds are conservative estimates, not hard allocator or wall-clock quotas.
Registered-root rational candidates and source-radius extension remain unsupported.
No upstream performance-parity claim or large-system Padé benchmark is made.
Python/stub-generation feature compilation passed; publication-host wheel/stub regeneration was not performed in this isolated task.

earlier_failures.pade-integration.log: Five of six passed; max_work=1 rejected the two-coefficient source during representation preflight, while the assertion expected the later work estimate message. The test now uses max_work=2 and reaches the intended guard.
earlier_failures.pade-check.log: Initial moved-series Rust ownership error, corrected with the native conversion ownership contract.
earlier_failures.pade-check2.log: Existing internal StepTrial fixtures needed the new candidate field/diagnostic argument.
earlier_failures.pade-clippy2.log: Native univariate accessor is coefficient_ring(), not ring(); corrected.
